Name: Auto Refill
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
[heading][b]Wireless Auto-Refill Chain (v1.1.0)[/b][/heading]
Take your farm automation to the next level with [b]Wireless Auto-Refill Chain[/b]. This mod allows you to create a seamless, wireless network between your chests and machines using nothing but the floor tiles beneath them.
[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]📡 Wireless Tile Connection:[/b] No more messy layouts! Any machine placed on a specific floor tile (like Wood Path, Stone Path, etc.) will automatically connect to any chest sharing the same tile type in the same area. This allows for long-distance automation without needing the machines to touch the chest.[/*]
[*][b]📈 Integrated XP System:[/b] Unlike other automation mods, you won't miss out on progress. You earn [b]Farming[/b] or [b]Mining XP[/b] automatically every time the mod harvests a finished product for you.[/*]
[*][b]📜 Quest & Achievement Tracking:[/b] Items collected by the mod are properly registered with the game's logic. This means harvested items will count toward your active [b]Quests[/b] and collection goals immediately.[/*]
[*][b]🔄 Intelligent Auto-Harvest & Refill:[/b] The mod instantly collects finished goods and refills machines with raw materials from the connected chest in a split second.[/*]
[*][b]🔗 Legacy Proximity Support:[/b] If no tiles are used, the mod still supports standard proximity-based automation (chests touching machines).[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Technical Note (Furnaces):[/b]
[quote][b]Current Status:[/b] Wireless support is fully optimized for most machines (Kegs, Jars, Mayonnaise Machines, etc.). For [b]Furnaces[/b], due to the complex nature of the game's coal/ore requirements, it is currently recommended to place them directly adjacent to the chest for the best experience. Full wireless support for Furnaces is being refined for future updates.[/quote][line]
[b]How to Use:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Place a [b]Chest[/b] on any floor tile (e.g., Wood Path).[/*]
[*]Place your [b]Machines[/b] on the same type of tile anywhere in the room or farm.[/*]
[*]Fill the chest with raw materials and watch your farm work by itself![/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Developed by:[/b] 66rayyan99
